commands.command: python docscan.py eval sample_data/corner.jpg sample_data/desk.jpg sample_data/nosheet.jpg sample_data/plain.jpg sample_data/tiles.jpg --ann sample_data/corners.json --seeds 20 --csv out/course/eval_median.csv --overlays out/course/eval_median

python docscan.py eval sample_data/corner.jpg sample_data/desk.jpg sample_data/nosheet.jpg sample_data/plain.jpg sample_data/tiles.jpg --ann sample_data/corners.json --seeds 20 --canny 50,150 --csv out/course/eval_fixed.csv --overlays out/course/eval_fixed

python docscan.py eval sample_data/corner.jpg sample_data/desk.jpg sample_data/nosheet.jpg sample_data/plain.jpg sample_data/tiles.jpg --ann sample_data/corners.json --seeds 20 --close 0 --csv out/course/eval_no_close.csv --overlays out/course/eval_no_close
python docscan.py scan sample_data/corner.jpg --method auto --canny 50,150 -o out/course/scans/corner_scan.png
python docscan.py binarize out/course/scans/corner_scan.png --method all --gt sample_data/page-gt.png -o out/course/scans/corner_bw.png
python docscan.py scan sample_data/desk.jpg --method auto --canny 50,150 -o out/course/scans/desk_scan.png
python docscan.py binarize out/course/scans/desk_scan.png --method all --gt sample_data/page-gt.png -o out/course/scans/desk_bw.png
python docscan.py scan sample_data/plain.jpg --method auto --canny 50,150 -o out/course/scans/plain_scan.png
python docscan.py binarize out/course/scans/plain_scan.png --method all --gt sample_data/page-gt.png -o out/course/scans/plain_bw.png
python docscan.py scan sample_data/tiles.jpg --method auto --canny 50,150 -o out/course/scans/tiles_scan.png
python docscan.py binarize out/course/scans/tiles_scan.png --method all --gt sample_data/page-gt.png -o out/course/scans/tiles_bw.png
python docscan.py binarize sample_data/L3/text-lamp.png --gt sample_data/L3/text-gt.png -o out/course/lamp.png
